notes: Implemented scraper using month sitemaps (https://www.cnnchile.com/_files/sitemaps/YYYY/MM.xml) plus recent sitemap_news and sitemap_lasts. Parsed URLs and used news:publication_date when available, otherwise lastmod as article date. Filtered to 2026-09-25..2026-10-25. Deduplicated and wrote TSV to data/urls_custom/cnnchile-com.tsv. Script prints per‑day counts; test run shows >15 URLs for 2026-09-30, 2026-10-10, 2026-10-20. Sample fetch of an article returned 123k characters, confirming length requirement. All HTTP via polite_fetch, respects robots.txt.
